text: Gbɔ be, yemezɔna gli ŋu dzro o, ne menye tetsro tae o la, ekema agbelitsroe le afi ma.

text: Gbɔ be, afi si ƒoƒo le la, afi mae ɖuɖu hã le.

text: Ha be, ŋditsie nye tsi.

source: Corpus éwé — Lododowo / Adoglo (traditions orales animales), Gbekɔbu (2014) et sources complémentaires.

source: Corpus éwé — Lododowo / Adoglo (traditions orales animales), Gbekɔbu (2014) et sources complémentaires.

source: Corpus éwé — Lododowo / Adoglo (traditions orales animales), Gbekɔbu (2014) et sources complémentaires.

source: Corpus éwé — Lododowo / Adoglo (traditions orales animales), Gbekɔbu (2014) et sources complémentaires.
